messages:
maria: Starting deploy now (canary to 5% in us-west). I'll watch the canary window for 10m. smoke checklist: health, 95th latency, error-rate, trace sampling. tagging @sam for ops handoff.
sam: on it. I’ll monitor infra dashboards and have rollback ready. ping me if 95th latency > +30% or errors > 0.5%.
dploy-bot: Deploy job #deploy-482 started by maria — canary 5% :: target us-west. link: https://deploys.internal/deploy-482
toni: quick Q — are we using the new kv-cache patch in this canary or still previous build? want to know expected cold-start behavior.
maria: this canary includes the kv-cache patch (v2.1.3). expected slightly higher cold token time on first requests, but stable after warmed.
alex: smoke run 01 results: health checks OK, 200/200, errors 0, 95th latency +12% vs baseline. small tail at 99th we should watch. logs: `service: inference runtime; msg: warmup complete; tail-latency-ms: 342`
sam: seeing a small bump in decode latency on a few pods, digging. CPU is fine, GPU util slightly higher on canary pods. rolling a tiny config tweak to batching window (from 20ms -> 15ms) to see effect.
ryan: rollback flag: ready (manual rollback script tested). If we see error-rate > 0.5% or sustained 95th latency > +25% for 5m, we should roll back.
maria: thanks. Sam — let me know after the tweak, we'll keep canary at 5% for full 10m unless something breaks.
sam: tweak applied at 1980012450. early numbers: 95th down to +8%, 99th down 10%. continuing to monitor.
toni: confirmed traces look cleaner after tweak. can we add an extra trace-sampling for canary for 5m? will help if we need to debug further.
maria: done — sampling bumped x3 for canary routes.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 10m mark — autoscope report: errors 0.02%, 95th +9%. next step: decide ramp to 25% or keep.
ryan: recommending ramp to 25% given stable metrics and rollback tested.
maria: ramping to 25% now. I'll post a final check at +15m after ramp. :white_check_mark:
alex: post-ramp smoke: health OK, small spike in kv-cache misses but throughput stable. logs snippet: ```kv_cache.miss=12 count=180 window=60s```
sam: kv-cache misses are within expected for ramp. no user-facing impact.
toni: thumbs up from infra side.
maria: OK closing the canary stage. moving to full rollout in 30m unless anyone objects. If anything looks off between now and rollout, call rollback. thanks all. :tada:
